description: The Advance Course on Green Hydrogen will enable impart a basic technical understating about the emerging field of Green Hydrogen in general and in India-in particular. By attending this course, the students shall be able to learn:About hydrogen energy fundamentals and about Green hydrogen emerging adoption for various applications.Green hydrogen production pathwaysIdentify the differences between green hydrogen, blue hydrogen, and the hydrogen rainbow.About the production, storage, and transportation methods of hydrogen.Applications of green hydrogen and impact on GHG emissions reductionCurrent trends, advancements, as well as potential career opportunities in the growing field of hydrogen energy.The pedagogy involved will be a mix of lectures, tutorials and practical training/exposure on green hydrogen systems

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Overview of hydrogen as an energy carrier and Green Hydrogen Value Chain, Global Warming Scenario and Net Zero ambitions

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONPURSUING: Pursuing 1st year of UG and continuous education
